description: Computes period-over-period movement per declared general-ledger account from integer minor-unit balances, compares each movement to a declared threshold policy (an absolute amount and a basis-point percentage, with a declared rule for whether one or both must be exceeded, plus optional per-account overrides), and ranks the breaches by absolute movement. Every breach needs a declared explanation id drawn from a caller-supplied reason-code list; a breach with none turns the gate to blocked, explained breaches route to review_required, and no breach reads clear. A zero prior balance never produces an infinite percentage: the percentage is reported as NOT_EVALUATED and the caller declares whether the absolute test alone applies or any movement breaches. Free-text explanations and account-number-like ids are refused. Flags movements over a declared threshold and requires a declared explanation id for each. It does not judge whether an explanation is adequate.
